documentation.content: An API instance reached its per-minute ceiling for crash reports (`client.errors_dropped`, CLIENT_ERRORS_MAX_PER_MINUTE) and is dropping the rest. Either something is badly broken for many users at once — check the crash-spike alert and Error Reporting — or someone is posting junk to POST /api/client-errors. For junk, look at `jsonPayload.activity="http.request" jsonPayload.path="/api/client-errors"` by `jsonPayload.ip`; the endpoint can be switched off with CLIENT_ERRORS_ENABLED=false without a redeploy of any app.
